correctness.rationale: Exact even-subgraph expansion on a simple cycle gives order-independent zero-field partition function and the pair correlation (T+P/T)/(1+P). Susceptibility is the weighted cyclic-window product sum. For fixed window length, integer strict convexity gives a unique minimum count multiset; a mechanical word attains all these minima, and the all-window balance discrepancy argument proves no other minimizers except rotations. Controlled geometric tails prove the equimolar infinite-volume formulas and positive (x-y)^2/[(1-x)(1-y)(1-xy)] difference. Direct standard-library exact arithmetic confirms 8,164 layouts, 238 independent Gibbs moment comparisons and 65 composition optima; computations only support, never substitute for, the general proof.

value.rationale: Fixed bond composition makes the zero-field free energy completely insensitive to order, whereas the physically natural uniform-field susceptibility changes. The theorem finds exact minimizers and a sharp evaluated formula for all finite n,m and all positive temperatures, and proves a nonzero thermodynamic penalty when the same equimolar inventory is segregated. This is structural equilibrium statistical mechanics, not a routine numerical constant, relabeling, or unconstrained special case.
